description: Adds an AI news target: type any topic and a model writes the news for you. Works with Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Grok, Qwen, Ollama and any OpenAI-, Anthropic- or Gemini-compatible endpoint. The target shows a short headline with a "Tap to view full" line underneath; tapping opens a full screen reader you can swipe between articles in, with buttons to close & dismiss or just close.
changelog:
- **Many AI providers**: Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Grok, Qwen, Together, Perplexity, Cerebras, Ollama and custom endpoints
- **Fetch models** and **Test key** buttons
- **Swipeable reader** with a dots overlay, one target with a "N stories to read" summary
- Articles in **GitHub Markdown** with a choice of length
- Localised into **Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese**
- **About** section with a link to the repository
- All builds share one signing key, so updates install over each other
